love.summary: Most readers sense new or rekindling romantic energy this week, with deepening feelings and potential long-term commitment on the horizon, so stay open to what resurfaces while being mindful not to sacrifice your existing priorities for it.
love.disagreement: Some readers emphasized an exciting new love interest arriving, while others focused on a complicated or returning connection resurfacing. One reader cautioned against compromising yourself for any new offer.

finance.summary: Most readers see financial rewards and new opportunities on the horizon this week, whether through a promotion, a recognized skill, or an emerging partnership, so stay open to offers and put your talents forward.
finance.disagreement: No notable disagreement among readers who discussed this theme.

career.summary: New professional opportunities appear to be emerging for Libra this week, whether through decisive personal action, the recognition of others, or the completion of existing work, so stay open to where these openings arrive from.

family.summary: Family themes this week range from joyful milestones and deepening bonds to more strained or one-sided connections, so focus on the relationships that genuinely nurture you while releasing what pulls you backward.

overall_tone_summary: A bright, optimistic current runs through Libra's week, with gentle caution threading beneath. Second week running.
